In their pursuit of a plan called [[Mandalorian Triumph]], a charge to take the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] enmeshed in the [[Mandalorian Wars]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] '''attacked''' the [[Exodeen system/Legends|Exodeen system]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] in [[3962 BBY]]. Coming off a [[Battle of the Quellor system (Mandalorian Wars)|victory]] at the [[Quellor system/Legends|Quellor system]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] won on Exodeen and then moved on to Duro, which they [[Battle of Duro (Mandalorian Wars)|successfully captured]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Exodeen [[Star system/Legends|system]] was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
